claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament has a $22.5 million total purse.
Rory McIlroy is the winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament takes home $4.5 million.
$4.5 million is 20% of the 2026 Masters Tournament purse.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament receives the green jacket.
The 2026 Masters Tournament purse is a $1.5 million increase from the previous year.
The 2026 Masters Tournament 1st place payout is $4,500,000.
The 2026 Masters Tournament 2nd place payout is $2,430,000.
The 2026 Masters Tournament 3rd place payout is $1,530,000.
The 2026 Masters Tournament 4th place payout is $1,080,000.
The 2026 Masters Tournament 5th place payout is $900,000.
The top 15 finishers in the 2026 Masters Tournament will split more than $17 million of the total prize pool.
The 2022 Masters Tournament purse was $15 million.
The 2022 Masters Tournament winner received a smaller portion of the purse than the 2026 Masters Tournament winner.
The 2026 Masters Tournament purse surpasses the previous record for the largest purse in major championship history
